content: SVG->PNG build-time rasterization 2026: sharp 0.35.4 (2026-08-26, active, prebuilt N-API binaries, no system libs, Node >=20.9.0, SVG input supported; text rendering via fontconfig so convert logo text to paths; must set density rather than resize to avoid blurry small icons). @resvg/resvg-js stale at 2.6.2 (2024-03). System alternatives in nixpkgs-unstable: librsvg 2.62.3 (rsvg-convert), resvg 0.48.1. Prefer sharp when the build must not require system packages.
